rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: All landlords in Boston who plan to end a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time they serve a Notice to Quit or Notice of non-renewal, and must separately report the notice (with tenant contact info and a copy of the notice) to the City through an online portal. Failure to comply can result in a warning (first offense) or a fine of up to $300 per day (second and subsequent offenses); a violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.key_value: $300 per day (2nd+ offense); warning for 1st offense; up to $300/day for failure to submit to city portal

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies to ALL landlords (and foreclosing owners) ending a tenancy agreement, regardless of building type or unit count; no exemptions stated in this source.

rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: fine of $300 per day
rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.
